instanceMethods.name: IsDoublePrecision
instanceMethods.comment: Return TRUE if vertex position should be stored with double floating point precision; FALSE by default.

instanceMethods.name: SetDoublePrecision
instanceMethods.comment: Set if vertex position should be stored with double floating point precision.

instanceMethods.name: HasNormals
instanceMethods.comment: Return TRUE if normals should be written; TRUE by default.

instanceMethods.name: HasTexCoords
instanceMethods.comment: Return TRUE if UV / texture coordinates should be written; FALSE by default.

instanceMethods.name: SetTexCoords
instanceMethods.comment: Set if UV / texture coordinates should be written.

instanceMethods.name: HasColors
instanceMethods.comment: Return TRUE if point colors should be written; TRUE by default.

instanceMethods.name: SetColors
instanceMethods.comment: Set if point colors should be written.

instanceMethods.name: HasPartId
instanceMethods.comment: Return TRUE if part Id should be written as element attribute; TRUE by default.

instanceMethods.name: SetPartId
instanceMethods.comment: Set if part Id should be written as element attribute; FALSE by default. Cannot be combined with `HasFaceId()`.

instanceMethods.name: HasFaceId
instanceMethods.comment: Return TRUE if face Id should be written as element attribute; FALSE by default.

instanceMethods.name: SetFaceId
instanceMethods.comment: Set if face Id should be written as element attribute; FALSE by default. Cannot be combined with `HasPartId()`.
